info.title: Camunda additions to the Snowflake SQL API spec

actions.description: The published server is a placeholder for one account. Drop it: the template asks for the account URL instead.
Every Snowflake account has its own host. The account variable becomes the template's account URL field.
Key-pair JWT needs a client-signed JWT and the SnowflakeOAuth implicit flow needs a browser, neither of which the REST connector can do.
Same as above, for the global security requirement.
Offer the two bearer token types the connector supports: a programmatic access token and an External OAuth access token.
The token type header is optional: Snowflake detects the token type from the token. Leaving it out lets one credential hold either token type.
